title: 1973 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Ox
seo_title: 1973 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Ox (3 February – 22 January 1974)
description: 1973 is the Year of the Water Ox (Yin, Gui-chou), from 3 February 1973 to 22 January 1974. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1973.
lead: Born in 1973? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Ox, but check the date: the 1973 Water Ox year began on 3 February 1973. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1973: Year of the Water Ox, from 3 February 1973 to 22 January 1974.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1973 was the Year of the Ox. It began with Lunar New Year on 3 February 1973 and ended on 22 January 1974, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1973 ends in 3, which makes it a Water year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1973 is a Gui-chou year. The same Water Ox combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1913 before it and 2033 after it.
Lunar New Year 1973 fell on 3 February 1973, so everyone born in January 1973, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rat.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Ox guide describes the sign like this: “Reliable, honest, and hard-working. Oxen build success slowly and steadily through persistence.” The usual watch-out: “Can be stubborn and slow to adapt to sudden change.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Ox page.
Careers often linked with the Ox: agriculture, engineering, finance, medicine.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1973
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Ox's best matches are the Rat, Snake and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Goat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Ox, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Ox, it sits directly opposite the Goat, so 2027 is its clash year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Ox years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1949 (Earth Ox); 1961 (Metal Ox); 1985 (Wood Ox); 1997 (Fire Ox). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1973 is the Year of the Ox, a Yin Water Ox year (Gui-chou).
When does the 1973 Year of the Ox start and end?
It starts on 3 February 1973 and ends on 22 January 1974.
I was born in January 1973. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rat: Lunar New Year 1973 was on 3 February 1973, so all of January 1973 belongs to the Rat year.
Water. 1973 ends in 3, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Ox compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Snake and Rooster. The Ox's clash sign is the Goat.
